evidence.text: Kevin attended clinic today. He has an established diagnosis of focal motor epilepsy.

His seizures typically occur in severe explosive clusters rather than isolated events. On 5 and 6 February 2025, over a 48-hour period, he suffered an acute cluster of 5 focal motor seizures with left facial and arm clonic activity. He had no seizures between that cluster and today's review. He reports no other seizure patterns or convulsions. He continues carbamazepine 400 mg twice daily.
No changes were made to his regimen. No EEG requested. Review in four months.
I reviewed Kevin in clinic today. His diagnosis remains focal motor epilepsy on carbamazepine 400 mg twice daily.
He experienced a further cluster of 4 focal motor seizures over 24 hours on 2 and 3 June 2025. Between clusters he remains entirely seizure-free. He reports no other semiologies.
Management maintained. Follow-up in four months.
Kevin attended for review. He suffered another cluster of 6 focal motor seizures over two days on 15 and 16 September 2025. No events since.
Carbamazepine continued. Routine review in six months.
